name: Availity Essentials
one_liner: Free clearinghouse connecting providers to 95%+ of US payers
short_description: Availity Essentials is a free healthcare information network that connects providers with payers for eligibility verification, claims status, prior authorization, and other real-time transactions.
description: Availity is the largest real-time health information network in the US, connecting over 3 million providers with health plans covering 95%+ of commercially insured patients. Availity Essentials provides free access to eligibility verification, claims status inquiry, prior authorization submission, and remittance advice. The platform serves as a clearinghouse and payer connectivity hub, eliminating the need for multiple payer portals. For enhanced features like automated workflows and analytics, Availity offers paid Essentials Pro.

free_trial.notes: Essentials is permanently free. Pro features can be trialed.

pricing.notes: Core Essentials is completely free. Funded by health plan partnerships. Pro tiers for advanced automation.

eligibility_verification.description: Real-time eligibility and benefits verification across 95%+ of payers

claims_status.description: Check claim status directly with payers without portal hopping

prior_auth.description: Submit and track prior authorization requests electronically

remittance.description: View and download electronic remittance advice (ERA/835)

features.payer_coverage: 95%+ of commercially insured patients in the US

best_for: Any practice wanting free eligibility verification

faqs.a: Yes, Availity Essentials is completely free for healthcare providers. The service is funded through partnerships with health plans. Basic features like eligibility verification, claims status, and prior authorization are free forever.

faqs.q: What payers does Availity connect to?
faqs.a: Availity connects to health plans covering 95%+ of commercially insured patients in the US. This includes major payers like UnitedHealthcare, Anthem, Aetna, Cigna, and hundreds of regional plans.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Availity Essentials and Essentials Pro?
faqs.a: Essentials is free and includes manual eligibility checks, claims status, and prior auth. Essentials Pro adds automation, batch processing, advanced analytics, API access, and enhanced support for $100-300/month depending on volume.

faqs.q: Can I use Availity for mental health eligibility verification?
faqs.a: Yes, Availity works for all healthcare specialties including mental health. You can verify behavioral health benefits, check authorization requirements, and submit prior authorizations to most commercial payers.
